text: 今年上半年保险业原保险保费收入同比增长3.3%，其中，外资保险公司同比增长12.4%，分红险同比增长94.4%，财险公司健康险同比增长15.2%……中国保险行业协会在7月31日召开的新闻发布会上用这组数字勾勒出行业“保费稳增，结构在变”的转型图景。申万宏源在研报中分析称，上半年A股上市险企合计归母净利润同比增长70.6%至3040.73亿元。中国保险行业协会预计，下半年保险市场将延续稳中有进的运行态势。（上证报）
text_en: In H1 this year, insurance industry original premium income grew 3.3% YoY, with foreign insurers up 12.4%, participating insurance up 94.4%, and property insurers' health insurance up 15.2%... China Insurance行业协会 outlined at July 31 press conference this set of numbers depicting the industry's transformation of "stable premium growth, changing structure." Shenwan Hongyuan analysis says H1 A-share listed insurers' combined net profit attributable to parent grew 70.6% to 304.073 billion yuan. China Insurance Association expects H2 insurance market to continue stable progress. (Shanghai Securities News)
